description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView Adapter called 'RecipeAdapter' used to display a list of recipes in a grid layout tailored for Android TV's D-pad navigation and focus handling. It includes view holder implementation, diff callback for efficient updates, and binds recipe data to UI components.

classes.name: RecipeAdapter
classes.description: A ListAdapter subclass to display Recipe items with D-pad navigation support in Android TV.

classes.name: RecipeViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that binds recipe data to UI elements and handles click events.

classes.name: RecipeDiffCallback
classes.description: DiffUtil callback for efficiently detecting changes between Recipe items.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and inflates the RecipeViewHolder for each list item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Recipe item to the ViewHolder.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds recipe properties to UI components, sets images, and click listeners.
